name: elastic-esql-query-generation
description: Use this skill whenever you are asked to generate ES|QL from natural language
content:
* always try to generate ES|QL using the `platform.core.generate_esql` tool before trying other methods.
* when using the `GROK` or `DISSECT` functions, always triple quote the expression.
* always test the generated ES|QL before providing it to the user.
* when testing, you only need to test against the subset of the data source filtered by the first `WHERE` clause.
* if during testing the generated syntax is found to be invalid, try to fix it before providing it to the user.
* if using `GROK` or `DISSECT` functions, and if during testing, no rows are returned, your pattern is likely slightly incorrect. try to fix it before providing it to the user.
